name: Jeet Kune Do
description: Strike the targeted enemy with Jeet Kune Do, and the last strike will Launch Up enemies, reducing the cooldown of '''Dragon's Defense''' with every hit.

stats.DAMAGE: The first four strikes each deal 35 damage, while the fifth strike deals 55 damage
stats.INTERVAL: The first four strikes have an interval of 0.45s between them, while the fifth strike has a 0.67s interval from the fourth strike

name: Yat Jee Chung Kuen
description: Dash forward to pursue the targeted enemy and unleash a flurry of attacks.

stats.PERCENTAGE DAMAGE: Deal damage equal to 2.7% of the target's Max Health

name: Living Chi
description: Become living Chi to boost his speed, damage, and attack range, delivering stronger punches while reducing the cooldown of Dragon's Defense.

name: Dragon's Defense
description: Assume a defensive stance with a boost of Chi to block incoming attacks and gain Damage Reduction. Once he exits the defensive stance, he gains Bonus Health and can strike back with Yat Jee Chung Kuen.

stats.CONVERSION RATE:
1.3 damage to bonus health conversion   
175 damage to max health conversion

name: K'un-Lun Kick
description: Dash forward, delivering a flying kick when hitting an enemy or reaching full range, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Damage increases with lower enemy health.

stats.DAMAGE:
35 (first kick)  
35 - 70 (second kick; maximum damage is achieved when the target is at 50% Health)

name: Harmony Recovery
description: Cross legs and channel Chi, recovering health. Excess healing converts to Bonus Health.

name: Crane Leap
description: Perform up to three consecutive jumps while airborne.

name: Chi Absorption
description: Assist in taking down enemies allow him to absorb their Chi and gain Bonus Health.

name: Lunar Chi
description: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Iron Fist and Emma Frost. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recover, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi. Emma Frost can project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. She can also enhance her diamond form, condensing frost into an Iced Out Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement.

stats.SPECIAL EFFECT: Excess healing converts to Bonus Health.
stats.HEALING RANGE: A cylindrical spell field with a 10m radius and a height of 10m.
